I understand that's frustrating, but yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and isn't covered under the Plant Care Guarantee.

Here's what to do: keep the plant out of direct sun for the first week, water only when the top inch of soil is dry (overwatering causes most early problems), and don't repot for 2–3 weeks. If the plant declines significantly beyond this—losing more than a third of its leaves overall—you can claim a free replacement within **30 days** of delivery through "My Orders" with two photos (whole plant + close-up).

If you'd like personalized care advice now, a Plant Care Specialist is available free by chat or email.
